summary:
SITARAX ASTROCARE is an offline-first space health monitoring prototype built to track astronaut vital signs, space weather, and mission readiness during deep-space missions. Using a React and FastAPI stack, it monitors simulated crew metrics—like heart rate, SpO₂, sleep, and stress—against personal baselines while pulling real-time solar activity data from NASA DONKI.
In deep space, communication delays and blackouts make constant Earth-based medical oversight impossible. ASTROCARE solves this by storing health readings locally offline, syncing automatically once reconnected, flagging early anomalies, and providing an evidence-backed AI Mission Copilot alongside instant PDF mission reports.
This matters because catching early signs of crew fatigue or physiological stress allows teams to adjust schedules proactively before minor issues become serious mission risks.
details: ASTROCARE is an offline-first space health dashboard designed to monitor astronaut vital signs and space weather during deep-space missions. It tracks simulated crew health data—including heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), sleep, stress, and daily activity—and compares them against personal baselines to spot early health changes. At the same time, it pulls live solar storm and radiation context from NASA’s DONKI and POWER APIs, bringing everything together with an interactive Digital Twin, a Mission Simulator, an AI Mission Copilot, and instant PDF health reports. Benefits & Intended Impact In deep space, communication delays and signal blackouts make constant medical support from Earth impossible. ASTROCARE solves this by saving health records offline inside the browser and syncing them automatically once the signal returns. Its goal is to help astronauts and flight teams catch early signs of fatigue or stress so they can adjust workloads before small issues become serious health risks. Tools & Technologies Used * Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS, and IndexedDB (for offline storage). * Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLite, httpx, and ReportLab (for PDF reports). * Data & Hosting: NASA DONKI & POWER APIs, NASA OSDR research metadata, GitHub, Cloudflare Pages, and Hugging Face Spaces. Creativity & Design Considerations Instead of just showing raw charts, ASTROCARE combines human health, live space weather, and offline reliability into one simple mission-control experience. Our team focused on clear communication—explaining health alerts in plain language—and strict scientific honesty by labeling all demo data as simulated and separating space weather context from personal radiation dose.
